verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own developer guide lists User Call Handling with State-based Rules, Call Handling Configurations and Call Forwarding Targets, which points to first-party call forwarding tied to user state. The plans page also describes managing calls on any device. The evidence is only navigation titles and marketing lines, so how deep and easy forwarding to an external cell is remains unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of forwarding the business number to an external cell, how away or after-hours rules trigger forwarding, admin/UI setup steps for a non-developer founder, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
